Semantic tokens for fork enum syntax.

-- settings.json --
{"semanticTokens": true, "analyses": {"unusedfunc": false, "staticcheck": false, "printf": false, "nilness": false, "unusedwrite": false, "yield": false}, "staticcheck": false}

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- enum.go --
package fork

enum Color { //@ token("enum", "keyword", ""), token("Color", "enum", "definition")
	Red //@ token("Red", "enumMember", "definition")
	Green
	Blue(int)
}

func f() {
	_ = Red //@ token("Red", "enumMember", "readonly")
}
